## Failure mode
Platform / infra failure. The container image pull timed out, so the sandbox never started and no Agent turn ran.

## Where it went wrong
Transcript line [2]: `sandbox failed to start: container image pull timed out after 120s (attempt 3/3)`. This is before the first Agent turn, so the AOP never executed. Steps 1 (Snowflake query) and 2 (Slack post) were never reached.

## Evidence
- `ERROR: sandbox failed to start: container image pull timed out after 120s (attempt 3/3).`
- Other context: "The last 3 Runs of this Agent (different days) failed with the identical sandbox error before any Agent turn."

## Fix
None in your artifacts. The AOP, Setup, and Connections are not implicated: the failure happens before any of them are read. Nothing you change in the AOP would prevent a sandbox that cannot pull its image.

## Next step
This needs to go to Duvo. The same error has repeated across four consecutive Runs on different days, so it is a recurring platform issue, not a one-off. I can't file the report from here, so please raise it with Duvo support from the Duvo web app and include:
- Run IDs: run_p01 and the three earlier failed Runs
- Build ID: bld_p01
- Exact error: `container image pull timed out after 120s (attempt 3/3)`
- What I ruled out: the AOP and Connections, since the failure occurs before any Agent turn.

If you want to retry in the meantime, a new Run may succeed if the image registry recovers, but I'd expect it to fail the same way until the platform side is fixed.
